results.description: Moving away from hierarchical agent teams (boss/worker) to micro-agencies where 3-5 specialized agents share a common context pool and bid on tasks. Highly discussed in e-commerce automation circles.
Handling multi-agent state by using event-driven graph memory instead of linear chat histories. Resolves context window limits when agents need to coordinate over days.
When agents deadlock waiting for each other, a separate 'watcher' agent with timeout capabilities forces state resets or injects random perturbations to break the loop.
